paper_summary: This paper investigates the relationships between solar flare properties and the associated coronal mass ejections (CMEs) by extrapolating solar observations to estimate mass and energy losses in active stellar coronae. The authors compile a database spanning 1996–2007 of soft X-ray flares observed by GOES and CMEs measured by LASCO on SoHO to establish power law relationships between flare X-ray fluence and CME mass and kinetic energy, and discuss implications for stellar mass loss and dynamo energy budgets.
